# self-evolving-agent

> A benchmark framework for self-evolving AI memory systems. Give any AI agent a memory that understands you better over time — memory layering, experience distillation, skill evolution, boundary guard. Local-first, Markdown-based.

## Key documents

- [README.md](README.md): Framework overview — the five layers and how they evolve together.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): Minimal executable design — a local-first Python CLI (`sea`) for managing Markdown memory.
- [memory-system/memory-layers.md](memory-system/memory-layers.md): How memory is layered (four layers: system / knowledge base / notes / experience) and how it maps to the five-layer framework.
- [distillation/mechanism.md](distillation/mechanism.md): How experiences are distilled into reusable rules and skills.
- [skill-evolution/skill-design.md](skill-evolution/skill-design.md): How skills are designed to self-improve.
- [boundary/privacy.md](boundary/privacy.md): Privacy and data sovereignty boundaries.
- [templates/](templates/): Ready-to-use templates (memory, anchor, constitution, task-log, profile).

- [examples/memory-sample.md](examples/memory-sample.md): Desensitized memory sample (L1/L2/L3).
